column2:
backpack(n./v.)背包、背包旅行
backpacker(n.)背包客
school backpack 書包
go backpacking 去自助旅行
He put his books in his backpack.
(他把書放進背包裡。)
They went backpacking around Europe last summer.
(他們去年夏天到歐洲自助旅行。)

backward(adj.)向後的、落後的
(無詞性變化)
a backward step 倒退的一步
backward area 落後地區
He left the room without a backward look.
(他頭也不回地離開了房間。)
The village was once poor and backward.
(那個村莊以前既貧窮又落後。)

backward(adv.)向後地、倒著
backwards(adv.)向後地、倒著(同 backward)
walk backward 倒著走
count backward 倒數
She took a step backward in surprise.
(她驚訝地向後退了一步。)
Can you say the alphabet backwards?
(你可以倒著唸英文字母嗎？)

badminton(n.)羽毛球
(無詞性變化)
play badminton 打羽毛球
badminton court 羽球場
We play badminton after school.
(我們放學後打羽毛球。)
Tai Tzu-ying is a famous badminton player.
(戴資穎是知名的羽球選手。)

bake(v.)烘烤
baker(n.)麵包師傅
bakery(n.)麵包店
bake a cake 烤蛋糕
freshly baked 剛烤好的
My mom bakes cookies on weekends.
(我媽媽週末會烤餅乾。)
I love the smell of freshly baked bread.
(我喜歡剛出爐麵包的香味。)

bakery(n.)麵包店、烘焙坊
bake(v.)烘烤
baker(n.)麵包師傅
local bakery 當地麵包店
bakery shop 麵包店
I buy bread at the bakery every morning.
(我每天早上在麵包店買麵包。)
The new bakery sells delicious pineapple cakes.
(新開的麵包店賣美味的鳳梨酥。)

balance(n./v.)平衡、餘額、使平衡
balanced(adj.)均衡的
keep one's balance 保持平衡
balanced diet 均衡飲食
She lost her balance and fell off the bike.
(她失去平衡從腳踏車上摔下來。)
It's important to balance study and rest.
(兼顧讀書和休息很重要。)

balcony(n.)陽台
(無詞性變化)
on the balcony 在陽台上
balcony door 陽台門
We grow flowers on our balcony.
(我們在陽台上種花。)
He hung his clothes on the balcony to dry.
(他把衣服晾在陽台上。)

balloon(n.)氣球
(無詞性變化)
blow up a balloon 吹氣球
hot-air balloon 熱氣球
The kids blew up balloons for the party.
(孩子們為派對吹氣球。)
We rode a hot-air balloon in Taitung.
(我們在台東搭了熱氣球。)

bar(n./v.)酒吧、條、棒、阻擋
(無詞性變化)
chocolate bar 巧克力棒
snack bar 小吃店
He ate a chocolate bar after the run.
(他跑完步後吃了一條巧克力棒。)
They met at a small bar downtown.
(他們在市中心一家小酒吧見面。)

barbecue(n./v.)烤肉、燒烤
BBQ(n.)烤肉(縮寫)
have a barbecue 烤肉
barbecue sauce 烤肉醬
Many families have a barbecue at Moon Festival.
(許多家庭在中秋節烤肉。)
Dad barbecued some chicken in the yard.
(爸爸在院子裡烤了一些雞肉。)

barber(n.)理髮師
barbershop(n.)理髮店
go to the barber 去理髮
barber shop 理髮店
I go to the barber once a month.
(我每個月去理髮一次。)
The barber cut my hair too short.
(理髮師把我的頭髮剪得太短了。)

bark(n./v.)吠叫、狗吠聲、樹皮
(無詞性變化)
bark at 對⋯吠叫
tree bark 樹皮
The dog barks at every stranger.
(這隻狗對每個陌生人吠叫。)
The bark of this tree is very rough.
(這棵樹的樹皮很粗糙。)

base(n./v.)基礎、底部、基地、以⋯為根據
basic(adj.)基本的
basis(n.)基礎、根據
be based on 根據⋯
military base 軍事基地
The movie is based on a true story.
(這部電影是根據真實故事改編的。)
Put the lamp on a strong base.
(把檯燈放在穩固的底座上。)

basic(adj.)基本的、基礎的
base(n.)基礎
basics(n.)基本原理
basically(adv.)基本上
basic skills 基本技能
basic needs 基本需求
Food and water are basic needs.
(食物和水是基本需求。)
You need basic computer skills for this job.
(這份工作需要基本的電腦技能。)

basics(n.)基礎、基本原理
basic(adj.)基本的
learn the basics 學習基礎
back to basics 回歸基本
First, let's learn the basics of cooking.
(首先，我們來學烹飪的基礎。)
The coach taught us the basics of tennis.
(教練教我們網球的基本功。)

basis(n.)基礎、根據
base(n.)基礎
basic(adj.)基本的
on a daily basis 每天
on the basis of 根據⋯
I check my email on a daily basis.
(我每天都會查看電子郵件。)
Trust is the basis of friendship.
(信任是友誼的基礎。)

bathe(v.)洗澡、給⋯洗澡、沐浴
bath(n.)洗澡
bathe a baby 幫嬰兒洗澡
bathed in sunlight 沐浴在陽光中
She bathes her dog every week.
(她每週幫狗洗澡。)
The garden was bathed in morning sunlight.
(花園沐浴在早晨的陽光中。)

battle(n./v.)戰役、戰鬥、奮鬥
(無詞性變化)
fight a battle 打仗
battle against 和⋯奮戰
Many soldiers died in the battle.
(很多士兵在那場戰役中喪生。)
She won her battle against illness.
(她戰勝了病魔。)

beard(n.)鬍子、絡腮鬍
bearded(adj.)有鬍子的
grow a beard 留鬍子
shave one's beard 刮鬍子
My uncle has a long gray beard.
(我叔叔留著灰色長鬍子。)
He decided to grow a beard this winter.
(他決定今年冬天留鬍子。)

beat(v./n.)打敗、敲打、(心臟)跳動、節拍
(無詞性變化)
beat the record 打破紀錄
heart beat 心跳
Our team beat them 3 to 1.
(我們隊以三比一打敗他們。)
My heart beat fast before the test.
(考試前我的心跳得很快。)

beauty(n.)美、美人
beautiful(adj.)美麗的
beautify(v.)美化
natural beauty 自然美景
beauty salon 美容院
Taroko is famous for its natural beauty.
(太魯閣以自然美景聞名。)
She is a real beauty.
(她真是個美人。)

beer(n.)啤酒
(無詞性變化)
a glass of beer 一杯啤酒
draft beer 生啤酒
Dad had a cold beer after work.
(爸爸下班後喝了一杯冰啤酒。)
You must be eighteen to buy beer.
(你必須滿十八歲才能買啤酒。)

beg(v.)乞討、懇求
beggar(n.)乞丐
beg for 乞求
I beg your pardon. 請再說一次。
The child begged his mom for a toy.
(那個孩子懇求媽媽買玩具。)
An old man was begging for food.
(一位老人在乞討食物。)

beginner(n.)初學者
begin(v.)開始
beginning(n.)開始
beginner level 初級程度
beginner's luck 新手運
This class is for beginners.
(這堂課是給初學者上的。)
I'm a beginner at swimming.
(我是游泳的初學者。)

behave(v.)表現、行為舉止、守規矩
behavior(n.)行為
behave oneself 守規矩
behave well 表現良好
Please behave yourself in class.
(上課時請守規矩。)
The kids behaved well at the party.
(孩子們在派對上表現得很好。)

being(n.)存在、生物、人
(無詞性變化)
human being 人類
come into being 形成、出現
Every human being needs love.
(每個人都需要愛。)
The school came into being in 1950.
(這所學校成立於1950年。)

belief(n.)信念、信仰、相信
believe(v.)相信
believable(adj.)可信的
religious belief 宗教信仰
strong belief 堅定的信念
He has a strong belief in hard work.
(他堅信努力的價值。)
People have different beliefs.
(人們有不同的信仰。)

bend(v./n.)彎曲、彎腰、轉彎處
(無詞性變化)
bend down 彎下腰
a sharp bend 急轉彎
She bent down to pick up the pen.
(她彎下腰撿起筆。)
Drive slowly around the sharp bend.
(在急轉彎處要慢慢開。)

better(adj./adv./n./v.)較好的、更好地、改善
(無詞性變化)
get better 好轉
had better 最好
I hope you get better soon.
(希望你早日康復。)
You had better finish your homework first.
(你最好先寫完功課。)

beyond(prep./adv.)超出、在⋯的另一邊、更遠處
(無詞性變化)
beyond one's reach 超出能力範圍
beyond belief 難以置信
The mountains lie beyond the river.
(那些山就在河的另一邊。)
This math problem is beyond me.
(這道數學題超出我的能力範圍。)

bill(n./v.)帳單、鈔票、法案、開帳單
(無詞性變化)
pay the bill 付帳
a hundred-dollar bill 一張百元鈔票
Let me pay the bill this time.
(這次讓我付帳吧。)
The phone bill is too high this month.
(這個月的電話費太高了。)

billion(n.)十億
(無詞性變化)
billions of 數十億的
one billion dollars 十億元
There are about eight billion people on Earth.
(地球上大約有八十億人。)
The company is worth a billion dollars.
(這家公司價值十億美元。)

birth(n.)出生、誕生
birthday(n.)生日
give birth to 生(孩子)
date of birth 出生日期
Please write your date of birth here.
(請在這裡寫下你的出生日期。)
The cat gave birth to four kittens.
(那隻貓生了四隻小貓。)

biscuit(n.)餅乾(英式)、小圓麵包(美式)
(無詞性變化)
chocolate biscuit 巧克力餅乾
tea and biscuits 茶和餅乾
Grandma served tea and biscuits.
(奶奶端出茶和餅乾。)
He ate a whole box of biscuits.
(他吃掉了一整盒餅乾。)

bit(n.)一點、小片
(無詞性變化)
a bit 有點
bit by bit 一點一點地
I'm a bit tired today.
(我今天有點累。)
She improved her English bit by bit.
(她的英文一點一點地進步。)

blackboard(n.)黑板
(無詞性變化)
write on the blackboard 在黑板上寫字
clean the blackboard 擦黑板
The teacher wrote the answer on the blackboard.
(老師把答案寫在黑板上。)
It's my turn to clean the blackboard.
(輪到我擦黑板了。)

blame(v./n.)責怪、歸咎、責任
(無詞性變化)
blame... for 因⋯責怪
take the blame 承擔責任
Don't blame me for your mistake.
(不要把你的錯怪到我頭上。)
The captain took the blame for the loss.
(隊長為輸球承擔了責任。)

blank(adj./n.)空白的、茫然的、空格
(無詞性變化)
fill in the blanks 填空
go blank 腦袋一片空白
Fill in the blanks with the right words.
(用正確的字填空。)
My mind went blank during the test.
(考試時我腦袋一片空白。)

blanket(n./v.)毯子、覆蓋
(無詞性變化)
a warm blanket 保暖的毯子
a blanket of snow 一層厚雪
She put a blanket over the sleeping baby.
(她在熟睡的寶寶身上蓋了毯子。)
The ground was covered with a blanket of snow.
(地面覆蓋著一層厚厚的雪。)

blood(n.)血、血液
bloody(adj.)流血的、血腥的
bleed(v.)流血
blood type 血型
give blood 捐血
What is your blood type?
(你的血型是什麼？)
My father gives blood twice a year.
(我爸爸一年捐血兩次。)

board(n./v.)木板、布告欄、董事會、登上(交通工具)
boarding(n.)登機、寄宿
on board 在船(機、車)上
bulletin board 布告欄
Please check the bulletin board for news.
(請查看布告欄上的消息。)
Passengers are now boarding the plane.
(乘客正在登機。)

boil(n./v.)沸騰、煮沸
boiling(adj.)沸騰的、極熱的
boiled(adj.)煮過的
boil water 燒開水
boiled egg 水煮蛋
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
(水在攝氏一百度沸騰。)
I had a boiled egg for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了一顆水煮蛋。)

bone(n.)骨頭
bony(adj.)骨瘦如柴的、多骨的
break a bone 骨折
bone marrow 骨髓
He broke a bone in his arm.
(他的手臂骨折了。)
The dog is chewing on a bone.
(那隻狗正在啃骨頭。)

bookstore(n.)書店
(無詞性變化)
used bookstore 二手書店
online bookstore 網路書店
I bought this novel at a bookstore.
(我在書店買了這本小說。)
There is a used bookstore near the station.
(車站附近有一家二手書店。)

border(n./v.)邊界、邊緣、與⋯接壤
(無詞性變化)
cross the border 越過邊界
border on 與⋯接壤
They crossed the border into Canada.
(他們越過邊界進入加拿大。)
France borders on Spain.
(法國與西班牙接壤。)

bother(v./n.)打擾、使煩惱、麻煩
(無詞性變化)
Sorry to bother you. 抱歉打擾你。
don't bother 不必費心
Sorry to bother you, but where is the library?
(抱歉打擾你，請問圖書館在哪裡？)
The noise didn't bother him at all.
(這噪音一點也沒打擾到他。)

brain(n.)腦、頭腦、智囊
brainy(adj.)聰明的
use your brain 動動腦
brain power 腦力
Reading is good for your brain.
(閱讀對大腦有益。)
Use your brain to solve the puzzle.
(動動腦解開這個謎題。)

branch(n./v.)樹枝、分店、分支、分岔
(無詞性變化)
branch office 分公司
branch out 拓展
A bird is sitting on the branch.
(一隻鳥停在樹枝上。)
The bank has a branch near my school.
(那家銀行在我學校附近有分行。)

brand(n.)品牌、商標
(無詞性變化)
brand name 品牌名稱
brand-new 全新的
What brand is your phone?
(你的手機是什麼牌子？)
He bought a brand-new bike.
(他買了一台全新的腳踏車。)

brief(adj./n./v.)簡短的、摘要、向⋯簡報
briefly(adv.)簡短地
in brief 簡言之
a brief talk 簡短的談話
The teacher gave a brief speech.
(老師做了簡短的致詞。)
In brief, we need more time.
(簡單地說，我們需要更多時間。)

brilliant(adj.)出色的、聰穎的、燦爛的
brilliance(n.)光輝、才華
brilliant idea 絕妙的主意
brilliant sunshine 燦爛的陽光
What a brilliant idea!
(真是個絕妙的主意！)
She is a brilliant young scientist.
(她是一位才華洋溢的年輕科學家。)

broad(adj.)寬闊的、廣泛的
breadth(n.)寬度
broaden(v.)拓寬
broad shoulders 寬肩膀
a broad range of 範圍廣泛的
He has broad shoulders.
(他有寬闊的肩膀。)
The library has a broad range of books.
(圖書館有種類廣泛的書。)

brush(n./v.)刷子、刷
(無詞性變化)
brush one's teeth 刷牙
paint brush 畫筆
Brush your teeth before bed.
(睡前要刷牙。)
She painted the wall with a big brush.
(她用一把大刷子粉刷牆壁。)

building(n.)建築物、大樓
build(v.)建造
builder(n.)建築工人
tall building 高樓
office building 辦公大樓
Taipei 101 is a very tall building.
(台北101是一棟非常高的大樓。)
My dad works in that office building.
(我爸爸在那棟辦公大樓上班。)

bun(n.)小圓麵包、包子、(頭髮)髻
(無詞性變化)
steamed bun 饅頭、包子
hot dog bun 熱狗麵包
I had two steamed buns for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了兩個包子。)
She wears her hair in a bun.
(她把頭髮盤成一個髻。)

burden(n./v.)負擔、重擔、使負擔
(無詞性變化)
a heavy burden 沉重的負擔
be a burden to 成為⋯的負擔
He doesn't want to be a burden to his family.
(他不想成為家人的負擔。)
Too much homework is a burden on students.
(太多功課對學生是一種負擔。)

burn(v./n.)燃燒、燒傷、燒傷處
burning(adj.)燃燒的、熾熱的
burn down 燒毀
get burned 被燙傷、曬傷
The old house burned down last night.
(那棟老房子昨晚被燒毀了。)
Be careful not to burn your hand.
(小心別燙到手。)

burst(n./v.)爆炸、破裂、突然發生
(無詞性變化)
burst into tears 突然哭出來
burst out laughing 突然大笑
The balloon burst with a loud bang.
(氣球砰的一聲爆了。)
She burst into tears when she heard the news.
(她聽到消息後突然哭了出來。)

businessman(n.)商人、生意人
business(n.)生意
businesswoman(n.)女商人
successful businessman 成功的商人
a businessman from Japan 一位日本商人
His father is a successful businessman.
(他父親是一位成功的商人。)
The businessman travels to China often.
(那位商人經常到中國出差。)
